pull.title: Let the retired-intake fleet reconciliation reach every house organization
pull.body:
The retired `agent-work-intake.yml` callers (pinned to `agent-work.yml@9941b91`, retired at source by 18a20a9) are still deployed in roughly 270 repositories and fail on blocked private-repository minutes. The reconciliation refused red-cup-engineering (868 repositories > 500 bound) and did not admit causeway-services.

- per-organization census bound 500 → 1000 repositories
- causeway-services admitted; up to all five house organizations per run
- blob identity, head preflight, 400-change budget and readback unchanged

`node --test test/retired-intake-fleet.test.mjs`: 9/9 pass. The 54 failures in `test/generated-source-receiving.test.mjs` (missing `src/placement/plan-allowances.mjs`) are identical on main and unrelated.
